result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban street with well-maintained sidewalks and a bus shelter. However, the lack of visible crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals at the signalized intersection creates a significant safety gap for people attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at a signalized intersection increases the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflicts as drivers may not expect people to cross.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge island.

result.summary: The image shows a wide one-way commercial street with wide sidewalks and signalized pedestrian crossings. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and pedestrian signals are present, the crossing lacks high-visibility painted markings and features a relatively long exposure distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of high-visibility markings
hazards.description: The crossing uses textured pavement rather than high-visibility painted markings, which may be less conspicuous to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street near the intersection can block the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway near the crosswalk

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Apply continental or zebra-style painted markings to the crossing to increase its visibility to motorists.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines for all road users.
